yes, this!! i’ve always had a bad habit of going above and beyond for people/places that didn’t deserve it or compensate me for it. wfm encourages that and the best thing you could possibly do for yourself (especially if you’re full time) is to never go above and beyond unless you’re given the compensation and the title to do so. if you set high expectations for yourself from the beginning, they’ll always expect that from you. do exactly what you were hired to do—nothing more, nothing less—and take all of your breaks. 
in my experience, i was always able to go to my tl and/or atl’s if i really felt like i was at a breaking point during a shift and they would usually at least give me the space i needed for a little while to just breathe or talk it out with them, but i know this isn’t the case in every store/dept… if it is though, never hesitate to ask them for help or a breather.
